LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.2 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Comprehension B
Topic 2.3: Reading for Understanding
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Understanding, part of Reading 2.2 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Comprehension B in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we enhance understanding while reading texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read vocabulary about essential places in town from flashcards (e.g.车站、 派出所、学校、邮局、医院、银 行),

2. match names of various essential places to simple descriptions of their use with peers,

3. read out words and phrases of names of the places from a word search collaboratively,

4. read texts depicting errands to be undertaken in the various essential places in town and explain the underlined key words and phrases with peers,

5. read the simple story given with the use of “要去” and “做什么” in turns to assess peers’ articulation of sentences,

6. answer questions based on the story collaboratively,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read vocabulary about essential places in town from flashcards (e.g.车站、 派出所、学校、邮局、医院、银 行),
2. match names of various essential places to simple descriptions of their use with peers,
3. read out words and phrases of names of the places from a word search collaboratively,
4. read texts depicting errands to be undertaken in the various essential places in town and explain the underlined key words and phrases with peers,
5. read the simple story given with the use of “要去” and “做什么” in turns to assess peers’ articulation of sentences,
6. answer questions based on the story collaboratively,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Understanding together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner exhibits knowledge of their surrounding when they identify the use of various essential places in their

town with peers.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively with peers to assess each other on their reading fluency and to complete

group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and mentorship: the learner receives constructive feedback from their peers on areas of strength and improvement

on their reading skills as they read descriptions on essential places.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links the skill of inferring the meaning of words while reading to comprehend the meaning of texts to English and

Kiswahili.
